GENES I S.
proue your ſavings to be true, and that you die not. They did as he had
ſaid, 11. and they talked one to an other : Worthily doe we ſuffer
theſe things, becauſe we haue ſinned againſt our brother, ſeeing the
diſtreſſe ot his ſoule whileſt he beſought vs, and we heard not : ther-
tore is this tribulation come vponvs. 22. Among whom Ruben one of
them, ſaid : Why, did not I ſay to you : Sinne not againſt the boy :
and you heard me not : Loe his bloud is tequired. 22. And they knew
not that Ioſeph vnderſtood : becauſe he ſpake to them by an interpreter.
24. And he turned away himfelte a litle while, and wept: and retur-
ning he ſpake to them. 25. And taking Simeon, and binding him in
theit preſence, he commanded his ſeruants that thcy ſhould fil vp
their ſackes with wheat, and put euerie mans money againe in theit
bags, gitung them beſides for to eate on the way : who did fo. 26. But
they catying their corne vpon theit aſſes , tooke their iourney. 27. And
one of them opening his ſacke to giue his beaſt prouender in the Inne,
beholding the money in the ſackes mouth, 28. he ſaid to his brethren:
My moncy is giuen me againe, behold it is in the ſacke. And being
aſtoniſhed and troubled amongſt themſelues , they ſaid : What is this,
that God hath done vuto vs? 29. And they came to Iacob their tather
into the land ot Chanaan, & thev told him al things that had chanced
vnto them, ſaving : 30. The Lord of the land ipake to vs roughly, &
thought vs to be ſpies of the prouince , 31. to whom we anſwered : We
are men ot peace , neither doe we attempt any treachery. 22. We are
twelue brethren borne ot one tather : onc is not liuing, the yongeſt is
with our tather in the Land of Chanaan, 33. Who faid tovs: Thus ſhal
trie that you be men ot peace : Leaue one of your brethren with me,
and take ve prouiſion neceſſarie for vour houſes, and goe your wayes,
42. and bring your yongeſt brother to me, that I may kuow you are not
ſpies : and you may recciue this telow againe, that is kept in priſon:
and afterwards iny haue licence to buy what things you wil. 25. This
being ſaid, wnen thcy powred out their corne , euerie man found his
money tied in the mouth of the ſackes: and al being aſtoniſhed toge-
ther, 36. theit father Iacob ſaid: Vou haue made me to be without
children, Ioſeph is not liuing , Simeon is kept in bonds, and Beniamin
vou wil take away: al theſe euils are fallen vpon me. 37. To whom
Ruben anſwered : Ril my two ſonnes, if I bring him not againe to
thee: deliuer him into my hand, and I wil reſtore him vnto thee. 28.
But he ſaid : My ſonne ſhal not goe downe with you : his brother is
dead, and he alone is remayning: if any aduerſitie ſhal chance to him
in the land to the which you goe , you ſnal bring downe (b) my hoare
lage, or, me an haires with ſorow vnto hel.
old man,
Ioſeph:
ANNO.
